reason: A DSH web GUI plugin that visualizes DeepSeek model pricing, token usage, cache-hit rates, and accumulated session cost in a configurable floating overlay.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中显示 DeepSeek 模型价格、真实 token 用量、缓存命中率和会话累计费用的可配置悬浮条。
summaries.en: A configurable DSH web interface overlay that displays DeepSeek model prices, actual token usage, cache-hit rates, and accumulated session costs.

capabilities: Reads session model and token-usage events
Calculates accumulated session costs using configurable pricing
Displays a draggable floating cost overlay and detail panel
Provides plugin settings and a loopback recalculation route
